verses.en: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
verses.sm: Ia faapea outou fafine, ia usiusitai i a outou lava tane, afai foi e le faalogo nisi i le upu, ia maua i latou i le amio lelei a avá, a e leai se upu,

verses.en: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
verses.sm: pe a latou vaai ane i a outou amio mamá ma le faaaloalo.

verses.en: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
verses.sm: Aua neʻi faia i le tino a outou teuga, o le fili lea o le lauulu, ma le teuteu i auro, ma le oofu i ofu;

verses.en: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
verses.sm: a o le tagata lilo o le loto, ia teua lea i le mea e le pala, o le loto agamalu ma le filemu, o le mea tau tele lava lea i luma o le Atua.

verses.en: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:
verses.sm: Aua sa faapea foi fafine paia anamua ona teuteu ia i latou, o e na faamoemoe i le Atua, na usiusitai i latou i a latou lava tane.

verses.en: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.
verses.sm: Sa faapea Sara ona faalogo ia Aperaamo, na ia taʻua o ia o le alii; ua fai foi outou ma ana tama. pe a agalelei ma le le mataʻu i se mea e tasi e mataʻu ai.

verses.en: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
verses.sm: la faapea outou tane, ia fai le áiga ma le poto, ia faautauta i le tino vaivai o le fafine, ma ava ia te ia ona ua tofia faatasi i le ola e foaifuaina mai, ina ne‘i faalavelaveina a outou tatalo.

verses.en: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
verses.sm: O le iuga lenei, ia loto gatasi outou uma, ia fealofani, ia alolofa i le au uso, ia mutimuti vale i le alofa, ia agalelei;

verses.en: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
verses.sm: aua le taui atu le leaga i le leaga, po o le agatele mai i le agatele atu; a ia outou faamanuia atu, ina ua iloa o le mea lenei na valaauina ai outou, ina ia maua e outou le manuia.

verses.en: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
verses.sm: Aua o le fia manao i le ola, ma ia iloa aso lelei, soia le tautala lona laulaufaiva i upu leaga, ma ona laugutu aua le tautalatala faa‘ole‘ole.

verses.en: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
verses.sm: Ia “alo ese i le leaga, a ia fai mea lelei; ia saili i le filemu ma tausisi i ai.

verses.en: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
verses.sm: Aud o fofoga o le Alii o loo faasaga i e amiotonu, e liliu mai foi ona taliga i a latou faatoga. A o fofoga o le Alii o loo faasaga ma le toasa i e fai ato leaga.

verses.en: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
verses.sm: O ai foi na te agaleaga ia te outou, pe afai tou te faaa‘oa‘o i le lelei?

verses.en: But and if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
verses.sm: A e afai e tigaina outou ona o le amiotonu, amuia outou. Aua foi tou te fefefe i lo latou faamatau mai, aua foi le atuatuvale.

verses.en: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
verses.sm: A ia paia le AW le Atua i o outou loto. la saunia pea lava outou e tali atu ma le agamalu ma le ava ia i latou uma o e fesili mai ia te outou i le uiga o le faamoemoe o loo ia te outou.

verses.en: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.
verses.sm: la ia te outou le loto fuatia ifo lelei, o le mea foi latou te faaleaga ai ia te outou, peiseai ua outou amio leaga, ia masiasi i latou o e tuna“ fua la outou amio lelei o ia Keriso.

verses.en: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
verses.sm: Aua afai e finagalo le Atua ia tigaina outou ona o le amio lelei, e sili ona lelei o lea i le tigaina ona o le amio leaga.

verses.en: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
verses.sm: Auá o Keriso foi na maliu o ia faatasi mo agasala, o le amiotonu mo e amioletonu, ina ia ta‘ita‘iina e ia o i tatou i le Atua; na fasiotia o ia i le tino, a ua faaolaina mai i le Agaga;

verses.en: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
verses.sm: na ia maliu atu ai, ma tala‘i atu ai i agaga i le fale puipui;

verses.en: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.
verses.sm: o e na le faalogo anamua, ina o faatalitali mai le onosai o le Atua anamua i ona po o Noa, a o sauni ai le vaa, na faasaojna ai tagata e toaitiiti, e toavalu lava ia, i le vai.

verses.en: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:
verses.sm: O le faatusa foi lea mea o le papatisoga, o loo faaola mai ai nei ia te outou, e le o le faateaeseina o le eleele o le tino, a o le tali a le loto fuatia ifo lelei i le Atua, i le toe tu mai o Iesu Keriso;

verses.en: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
verses.sm: o ia o loo i le itu taumatau o le Atua, ina ua afio ae o ia i le lagi, ua toilalo ia te ia o agelu, ma faipule, malolosi.
